claim.quote: In combination with the results of the neutron-spin sensitive XENON10 experiment, these results yield a limit of |a_p| < 0.32 for M_W = 50 GeV/c2 on the spin-dependent sector of weakly interacting massive particle-nucleus interactions

name: First Results of the Phase II SIMPLE Dark Matter Search

summary.plain: First half of SIMPLE's Phase II run: 15 droplet detectors, 14.1 kg days, giving a spin-dependent limit that, combined with XENON10, cut the previously allowed region of parameter space by half.
summary.technical: 14.1 kg d with 15 detectors of 0.208 kg total active mass; |a_p| < 0.32 at 50 GeV/c^2 (with XENON10); spin-independent limit 2.3e-5 pb at 45 GeV/c^2.

title: First Results of the Phase II SIMPLE Dark Matter Search
why_it_matters: The abstract states a 50% reduction in the previously allowed region of the phase space formerly defined by XENON, KIMS and PICASSO.
